operations.description:
Create new moderator account with authentication token issuance.

This endpoint enables new moderators to register for the politicsBBS discussion board system. The registration process includes comprehensive validation to ensure security and uniqueness within the system.

The registration flow validates that usernames contain only letters, numbers, and hyphens with a length between 3-20 characters, following the requirements defined in the politics_bbs_moderators schema. Email addresses must be unique across the system, with proper format validation according to standard email specifications. Passwords must meet security requirements including minimum 8 characters with at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, and one number.

Upon successful validation, the system creates a new moderator record in the politics_bbs_moderators table with a unique identifier and securely hashed password using appropriate salting algorithms. The system generates both access token (15-minute expiration) and refresh token (30-day expiration) following JWT standards for immediate authentication.

The response includes complete moderator profile information, authentication tokens with proper expiration settings, and role-specific permissions for content moderation activities. This enables new moderators to immediately begin accessing moderation functionality after successful registration.

Error handling covers duplicate username scenarios, duplicate email addresses, password format violations, and external registration restrictions. All responses follow standard HTTP status codes with detailed error messages that help users understand validation failures and take corrective actions.

operations.description:
Authenticate moderator credentials and issue access tokens.

This endpoint handles moderator authentication by validating username/email and password credentials against the politics_bbs_moderators table. The login process implements comprehensive security measures to protect against unauthorized access while providing reliable authentication for legitimate moderator users.

The system accepts either username or email as the primary credential, providing flexibility for moderator login preferences. Password validation uses the securely stored password_hash from the moderator record, implementing proper cryptographic verification with timing attack resistance. Failed login attempts are tracked for security monitoring.

Upon successful credential validation, the system generates a new session record in the politics_bbs_moderator_sessions table with IP address tracking, referrer information, and comprehensive audit details. This supports security monitoring and administrative oversight of moderator account access patterns.

JWT token generation produces access tokens with 15-minute expiration for API access and refresh tokens with 30-day expiration for session management. Tokens include moderator identifier, username, role confirmation, and comprehensive permission set for content moderation activities including article review, comment moderation, and user management capabilities.

The response provides complete profile information including moderator ID, username, email address, creation timestamp, and account status. Token information includes both access and refresh tokens with proper expiration times, enabling immediate access to moderator-specific functionality across the discussion board platform.

Refresh moderator access tokens using valid refresh tokens.

This endpoint extends moderator authentication sessions by validating existing refresh tokens and issuing new access tokens without requiring users to re-enter their credentials. The refresh process implements token rotation security measures while maintaining continuous access to moderation functionality.

The refresh token validation occurs against active session records in the politics_bbs_moderator_sessions table, ensuring the token corresponds to a valid, non-expired session. Invalid or expired refresh tokens result in authentication failure, directing users to re-authenticate through the login process.

Upon successful validation, the system generates a fresh access token with 15-minute expiration for immediate API access while maintaining the existing refresh token validity. This approach balances security with convenience, preventing token reuse while extending session duration for ongoing moderator activities.

Token generation creates access tokens containing moderator identifier, username confirmation, role verification, and comprehensive permission set including article approval workflows, comment moderation, content review, user warning systems, and community management tools. Token metadata includes creation timestamp, expiration time, and session identification for audit tracking.

The response maintains compatibility with the original login response format, providing updated access tokens, refreshed expiration times, moderated profile information, and complete permission sets for seamless continuation of content management activities across the politicsBBS platform.

It handles cleanup of presentation flags while preserving audit trail information including creation timestamp, content, and moderation history.

This soft-delete approach maintains conversation integrity among threaded discussions while allowing content removal for the original author. The operation integrates with the member-specific comment management system through proper subtype relationships.

operations.description:
This operation enables advanced search and filtering across the politicsBBS article content, providing users with comprehensive discovery capabilities beyond simple category browsing. The system accepts complex search parameters including keyword queries, category filters, date ranges, and sorting preferences to deliver highly targeted article results.

The search implementation supports both title-only queries and full-content searches using PostgreSQL's text search capabilities with trigram indexing. Users can filter results by specific categories (Economic Policy, Political Analysis, International Relations, etc.) to focus on topics of interest. Date filtering allows discovery of recent content or historical perspectives within specified timeframes.

The operation supports multiple sorting options including chronological order (newest first), relevance ranking for keyword searches, and popularity ordering based on view counts. Pagination delivers results in manageable chunks while maintaining search context and filter state across page requests.

Advanced search parameters accommodate power users who need sophisticated filtering options such as minimum view counts, specific author filtering, or exact phrase matching. The system maintains search history for authenticated members and allows saved searches for frequently used queries.

The search results include rich metadata for each article including creation timestamps, view counts, comment counts, category assignments, and author information to aid in content evaluation without requiring additional data requests.

This is a computed operation that aggregates data from multiple tables including politics_bbs_articles, politics_bbs_comments, and user content, returning unified search results with proper pagination and filtering capabilities.

Search results are ranked by relevance using a combination of text similarity scores and recency weighting.

This unified search endpoint serves as the primary discovery mechanism for users to find relevant discussions, policy analyses, and economic discourse across the entire platform. The search algorithm prioritizes recent content while maintaining relevance to the search query, ensuring users can easily locate both current and historical discussions on political and economic topics.

Uploaded files are associated with the authenticated user and can be linked to articles during creation or editing. The operation supports multiple file formats including JPEG, PNG, GIF for images and PDF, DOC, DOCX, TXT for documents. Handle file uploads for the politicsBBS discussion board supporting both image and document attachments. The upload process includes comprehensive validation to ensure file safety and compliance with platform requirements.

For image uploads, the system accepts JPEG, PNG, and GIF formats with a maximum file size of 5MB per image. Images are automatically processed to generate thumbnails and optimized versions for web display. The system allows up to 10 images per article and maintains proper aspect ratios while creating responsive versions for mobile devices.

Document uploads support PDF, DOC, DOCX, and TXT formats with a maximum size of 10MB per file. Users can attach up to 5 documents per article. All uploaded files undergo malware scanning and content validation before being accepted. The system generates preview thumbnails for supported document types and stores files with secure access controls.

File uploads are associated with the authenticated user's account and maintain proper audit trails. The operation returns file metadata including unique identifiers, file paths, and processing status that can be used when creating or editing articles to attach the uploaded files.

IPoliticsBbsVisitorUser.IJoin.description:
Request body for visitor account registration on the politicsBbs discussion board. Creates temporary guest accounts that provide session management for unauthenticated users, enabling tracking of visitor activity and basic personalization features. Visitor accounts receive limited JWT tokens for session continuity while maintaining appropriate security for guest users.

This registration DTO supports the politicsBBS platform's visitor system for temporary access to political and economic discussions. The visitor accounts provide basic session management capabilities while maintaining anonymity and limited privileges appropriate for guest users.

The authentication model supports different user types through a polymorphic ownership pattern where visitors, members, and moderators have distinct access levels and capabilities. Visitor accounts are designed for temporary browsing of economic policy discussions and political analysis content.

The session tracking fields (ip, href, referrer) enable comprehensive audit trails and analytics for visitor behavior analysis while maintaining appropriate privacy boundaries for guest users who browse political discourse content.

Username validation ensures consistent display across article access and comment viewing activity while preventing impersonation or confusion with authenticated member accounts in the discussion forum interface.

href.description: Connection URL (current page URL) - MANDATORY. Provides session context for tracking visitor entry points and navigation patterns. Must be a valid URI format reflecting the actual page from which registration is initiated.

ip.description: Client IP address for session tracking and audit purposes. Optional field that may be provided by the client for SSR scenarios or when server cannot reliably extract IP from request headers while maintaining privacy boundaries for visitor accounts.

password.description: Password for the visitor account. Must meet complexity requirements: minimum 8 characters including at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, and one number. Used for authentication and session management with visitor-level security constraints reflecting temporary account nature.

referrer.description: Referrer URL (previous page URL) - MANDATORY. Tracks how visitors arrive at the site for analytics and session attribution. Must be a valid URI format representing the page that led to registration, can be empty string for direct access.

username.description: Unique username for the visitor account. Must be 3-20 characters using only letters, numbers, and hyphens. Used for display purposes and session identification in visitor contexts while excluding personal identifiers appropriate for guest accounts.

IPoliticsBbsVisitorUser.IAuthorized.description:
Response body for visitor authorization on the politicsBBS discussion board. Provides comprehensive visitor account details with JWT authentication tokens for session management across the political and economic discourse platform.

This authorization response contains the complete visitor account profile following successful authentication, supporting the polymorphic ownership pattern where visitors receive limited session capabilities appropriate for temporary guest users engaging with policy discussions and economic analysis content.

The response structure enables visitor session management through JWT tokens while maintaining appropriate security boundaries for unauthenticated users browsing political discourse and economic policy debates. Visitor accounts support read-only access to approved articles, comments, and community discussions.

Account details include unique visitor identification with timestamps for activity tracking and session management across the discussion platform. The JWT tokens provide secure authentication for subsequent API interactions while reflecting the temporary nature of guest user access to political and economic content.

The visitor system enables basic platform functionality including article browsing, comment viewing, and search operations while maintaining appropriate security constraints for guest users who engage with political discourse and economic policy analysis through the politics discussion board interface.

id.description: Unique visitor identifier from politics_bbs_visitors.id field. This UUID serves as the primary key for visitor session management and security auditing across the discussion platform.

username.description: Visitor's username from politics_bbs_visitors.username field used for display and session identification in visitor contexts with URL-safe formatting constraints.

password_hash.description: Secure password hash from politics_bbs_visitors.password_hash field used for authentication verification using bcrypt or similar secure hashing algorithms.

created_at.description: Visitor account creation timestamp from politics_bbs_visitors.created_at field tracking when the temporary guest account was established on the platform.

last_seen_at.description: Last visitor activity timestamp from politics_bbs_visitors.last_seen_at field for session timeout and activity analytics in visitor contexts.

refresh_token.description:
The refresh token used to obtain a new access token. This long-lived token is stored in the session management tables and enables secure token rotation for maintaining session continuity without requiring re-authentication.

The refresh token implements a security-by-design approach to session management, providing:
- Extended session validity without exposing long-term credentials
- Automatic token rotation to maintain security hygiene
- Temporary nature reflecting guest session requirements
- Graceful session expiration handling

This token is particularly crucial for visitor sessions that need temporary guest account functionality while maintaining appropriate security boundaries for unauthenticated users who access the political discussion platform.

IPoliticsBbsUser.IRefresh.description:
Request body for refreshing authentication tokens on the politicsBbs discussion board system. This DTO enables visitor sessions and member accounts to maintain active authentication state by exchanging valid refresh tokens for new access tokens.

The refresh mechanism provides a balance between security and user experience:
- Long-lived refresh tokens stored securely in session tables
- Short-lived access tokens for regular API operations
- Automatic token rotation to prevent session hijacking
- Graceful handling of expired tokens with appropriate error responses

For visitor sessions, this endpoint supports temporary guest accounts that can maintain viewing history and basic platform preferences while preserving the security model appropriate for unauthenticated sessions. Member accounts receive standard JWT management with session management tables tracking their security context.

The refresh process validates existing tokens against database records, ensures token integrity, and generates new tokens with updated expiration times while maintaining the user's authentication context. This design ensures both security and session continuity for iBbs platform users.

username.description: Unique username for new member account (3-20 characters using letters, numbers, and hyphens only)

email.description: Email address for account recovery and notifications (must be unique across politics_bbs_members table)

password.description: Password for new account (minimum 8 characters with at least one uppercase, one lowercase, and one number)

ip.description: Client IP address for session tracking (optional - server can extract but client may provide for SSR)

href.description: Connection URL (current page URL) - required for self-signup session context

referrer.description: Referrer URL (previous page URL) - required for self-signup session context

Member registration request for creating new member accounts on the politics discussion board. Enables new users to join the platform and obtain posting privileges including article creation, commenting, and file uploads.

Session context fields (ip, href, referrer) are required for self-signup operations to enable proper audit trails and security monitoring. The backend automatically creates a new entry in the politics_bbs_member_sessions table using this context data.

This token is managed through the politics_bbs_member_sessions table to maintain secure session continuation for economic and political discourse platform users.

Must be unique across the politics_bbs_moderators table as defined in the Prisma schema with proper format validation according to standard email specifications. Used for password resets and important system notifications while ensuring system-wide uniqueness for security.

password.description: Secure initial password meeting complexity requirements as specified in the politics_bbs_moderators.password_hash field requirements. Must be minimum 8 characters including at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, and one number. The password is hashed using secure algorithms with appropriate salting before storage in the politics_bbs_moderators.password_hash field following security best practices for authentication credential management.

IPoliticsBbsModerator.ICreate.description: Request body for creating new moderator accounts through administrative processes. Enables system administrators to establish new moderation accounts with validation requirements while ensuring proper credential management and audit trail creation for administrative accountability. This DTO supports the polymorphic actor system where moderators have distinct permissions for content review, moderation workflows, and community management activities on the politics discussion board.

id.description: Confirmed moderator account identifier for authorization and session management linking to politics_bbs_moderators.id. This UUID serves as the primary key linking the moderator to all moderation activities, content reviews, and administrative actions across the politicsBBS discussion board platform while maintaining proper referential integrity with the politics_bbs_moderators table.

username.description: Verified moderator username for display and administrative identification purposes as stored in politics_bbs_moderators.username field. This is the public identifier used throughout the platform for moderator actions and is displayed to users when content undergoes moderation review on the political and economic discussion board system.

email.description: Confirmed email address for administrative communications and account verification from the politics_bbs_moderators.email field. This address is used for password reset requests, system notifications, and urgent moderation-related communications while maintaining system-wide uniqueness and proper formatting validation according to standard email specifications.

created_at.description: Account creation timestamp from the politics_bbs_moderators.created_at field used for understanding moderator tenure and administrative purposes. This timestamp is utilized for audit trails, privilege escalation tracking, and administrative reporting within the moderation system while maintaining proper temporal context for administrative accountability across the politics discussion board moderation workflow.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent moderator profile update from the politics_bbs_moderators.updated_at field. This field tracks when moderator information was last modified and is used for change detection and administrative oversight while maintaining proper audit trail requirements for administrative activities on the politicsBBS platform.

deleted_at.description: Soft delete timestamp for moderator account suspension corresponding to the politics_bbs_moderators.deleted_at nullable field. When present, indicates that the moderator account has been suspended or deactivated, preventing access to moderation functionality while preserving audit trail information within the polymorphic actor system for administrative oversight and accountability tracking.

This response maintains comprehensive audit trail capabilities while supporting the polymorphic actor system within the politics discussion board platform for administrative content governance and community moderation workflows.

username_or_email.description:
Moderator's username or email address for authentication.

Accepts either a 3-20 character username (letters, numbers, hyphens only) or
a valid email address as the authentication credential. This flexibility
supports different moderator login preferences while maintaining security
through proper format validation and database username uniqueness constraints.

password.description:
Moderator's password for authentication verification.

Must meet security requirements of minimum 8 characters including at least
one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, and one number. The password is
verified against the securely stored password_hash in the politics_bbs_moderators
table using bcrypt or similar secure hashing algorithms.

oneOf.description: Client IP address for session tracking - optional but recommended
Optional null value when IP cannot be determined

ip.description:
Client IP address for session context and audit logging.

An optional field that provides valuable context for moderator session
tracking and geographic analysis of administrative access patterns.
When not provided, the server attempts to extract the IP from the connection
metadata, but client provision can improve accuracy, especially in SSR contexts.

href.description:
Connection URL for session audit tracking - required field.

The current page URL from which the login originated, used for audit tracking
and session context. This field is mandatory to maintain comprehensive logs
of moderator authentication events and support proper security monitoring
of administrative access to the politicsBBS platform.

referrer.description:
Referrer URL for session audit tracking - required field.

The page URL that led the moderator to the login page, providing context
for understanding navigation patterns and supporting security analysis.
This required field helps track moderator access sources and maintain
comprehensive audit trails for administrative activity on the politicsBBS
discussion board platform.

id.description: Primary key. Unique identifier for the moderator.

username.description: Unique username for moderator identification, 3-20 characters using letters, numbers, and hyphens only.

password_hash.description: Hashed password for moderator authentication using secure algorithms with appropriate salting.

email.description: Email address for moderator communications and account recovery, must be unique across the system.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the moderator account was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent moderator profile update.

deleted_at.description: Soft delete timestamp for moderator account suspension.

IPoliticsBbsModerator.description: Moderator accounts with enhanced permissions for content review, approval workflows, and community management. Moderators can review all content and manage user violations.

IPoliticsBbsModerator.IUpdate.description: Request body for moderators to update their own profile information on the politicsBbs discussion board. Enables self-service profile management while maintaining security boundaries and comprehensive validation requirements. Supports secure updates to username, email, and other profile fields while preserving audit trails for administrative accountability within the moderation system. This DTO implements partial update patterns where only provided fields are modified, following REST API conventions for PUT operations on user profiles.

email.description: Updated email address for notifications and account recovery. Must be unique across the politics_bbs_moderators table and properly formatted according to standard email address specifications. Used for moderator communications, account verification, and password reset workflows. This field directly corresponds to the politics_bbs_moderators.email column and supports the authentication system's email-based recovery mechanisms.

username.description: Updated moderator username for display purposes. Must be 3-20 characters using only letters, numbers, and hyphens to maintain consistency with the politics_bbs_moderators.username field validation constraints. This enables unique identification across the moderation team while ensuring compatibility with URL generation and system interfaces. The validation pattern directly maps to database constraints enforced at the Prisma schema level.

IPoliticsBbsModerator.IRefresh.description: Token refresh request for moderator authentication sessions on the politicsBbs discussion board. Enables continuous administrative access without requiring re-authentication by exchanging valid refresh tokens for new access tokens. This operation creates comprehensive audit entries in the politics_bbs_moderator_sessions table with detailed connection metadata for security monitoring of administrative activities. The refresh mechanism supports extended moderator sessions through secure token rotation while maintaining appropriate security boundaries for content management operations.

href.description: Connection URL or current page location for session context and audit trail tracking. Mandatory requirement for moderator refresh operations to maintain comprehensive access logs within the politics_bbs_moderator_sessions table. Used to track administrative navigation patterns and validate session authenticity while supporting security monitoring for moderation tool access. Must be a valid URI format pointing to the current moderation interface location.

ip.description: Client IP address for session tracking and security audit purposes. Optional field providing comprehensive security monitoring context for administrative access patterns. When not provided, the server can extract from connection metadata, but client provision enables enhanced security verification for SSR contexts or geographic access analysis. This corresponds to the politics_bbs_moderator_sessions.ip field for audit trail maintenance.

referrer.description: Referrer URL showing how the moderator arrived at the refresh endpoint. Mandatory field for comprehensive audit trails within the politics_bbs_moderator_sessions table. Used to maintain complete access history and understand administrative navigation patterns across the moderation interface. Must be a valid URI format showing navigation source for professional administrative session management and security compliance.

IPoliticsBbsModerator.ISummary.description:
Lightweight summary representation of moderator accounts for display in administrative interfaces, audit logs, and reference contexts. Provides essential information for identifying moderators without exposing sensitive authentication data or excessive metadata. This summary type is specifically designed for list views, audit trails, and interface displays where only basic moderator identification is needed.

Features essential moderation administration data:
- Unique identifier for moderator reference and linking
- Username for public moderator identification across the platform  
- Email address for administrative communications and contact
- Creation timestamp for understanding moderator tenure and experience
- Minimal personal data exposure maintaining security boundaries

This summary enables efficient rendering of moderator information while protecting sensitive data and maintaining appropriate privacy boundaries for administrative operations within the politics discussion board moderation system.

id.description: Unique identifier for quick reference to the moderator account - references politics_bbs_moderators.id for system operations

username.description: Display name for moderator identification in administrative interfaces and audit trails - corresponds to politics_bbs_moderators.username field

email.description: Email address for contact purposes in admin panels and moderation notifications - references politics_bbs_moderators.email field

created_at.description: Account creation date for understanding moderator tenure and administrative history - matches politics_bbs_moderators.created_at field

IPoliticsBbsModerator.IPassword.description:
Request body for secure moderator password changes. Requires current password verification for security while implementing comprehensive validation for new passwords. Enables credential renewal while maintaining account security and preventing unauthorized access attempts through proper authentication checks.

This DTO specifically handles password update operations for moderator accounts with enhanced security requirements. The structure focuses on the single security-critical field requiring validation while supporting comprehensive password strength checking for administrative accounts.

Security features implemented:
- Minimum 8 character length requirement for password complexity
- Mixed case requirements (uppercase and lowercase letters)  
- Numeric character requirement for additional security
- Pattern validation to ensure policy compliance
- Secure password hashing preparation via password_hash field notation
- Length limits to prevent oversized or invalid data

The design maintains security best practices while balancing ease of use for authorized moderator access changes within the politics discussion board administrative system.

password.description: New secure password meeting platform security requirements (minimum 8 characters with uppercase, lowercase, and numeric characters) - corresponds to politics_bbs_moderators.password_hash field with bcrypt hashing applied

id.description: Primary key. Unique identifier for the category.

code.description: Unique category code for internal reference and URL generation. Must be unique across the system.

name.description: Display name for the category shown to users.

description.description: Detailed description of the category's purpose and scope.

color.description: CSS color code for visual identification of the category.

sequence.description: Display order for category sorting in lists.

primary.description: Whether this is a primary featured category.

required.description: Whether this category is required to be assigned.

multiplicative.description: Whether multiple categories can be assigned to content.

created_at.description: Category creation timestamp.

IPoliticsBbsCategory.description: Predefined categories for organizing politicsBBS articles and discussions. Categories facilitate content discoverability and filtering, focusing on economic and political topics as specified in the requirements. Categories are created and managed by moderators through the system interface.

id.description: Category identifier from politics_bbs_categories.id field serving as the primary key for category references across the politicsBBS discussion board platform.

code.description: Unique category code from politics_bbs_categories.code field for internal reference, URL generation, and programmatic access within the politics discussion board API endpoints.

name.description: Display name from politics_bbs_categories.name field shown to users in interfaces, search filters, and navigation menus for political and economic content discovery.

created_at.description: Timestamp from politics_bbs_categories.created_at field tracking when the category was first established in the system for administrative reference and audit purposes.

updated_at.description: Timestamp from politics_bbs_categories.updated_at field reflecting the most recent modification to category configuration settings by moderation admin or system maintenance operations.

deleted_at.description: Soft delete timestamp from politics_bbs_categories.deleted_at field indicating when the category was logically removed from active use while preserving historical associations for audit trail compliance.

sequence.description: Display order from politics_bbs_categories.sequence field controlling category positioning in user interfaces and navigation hierarchies across the political discussion platform.

primary.description: Primary category flag from politics_bbs_categories.primary field determining prominent display placement within the politicsBBS system for core economics and political discussion areas.

required.description: Required category flag from politics_bbs_categories.required field indicating whether category assignment is mandatory for article submissions to maintain consistent organization.

multiplicative.description: Multiplicative flag from politics_bbs_categories.multiplicative field enabling multiple simultaneous category assignments for nuanced political and economic discussion topics.

color.description: CSS color code from politics_bbs_categories.color field providing visual differentiation in category selectors and user interfaces for the politics discussion board platform.

icon.description: Icon identifier from politics_bbs_categories.icon field enhancing visual recognition and category browsing experience throughout the political and economic discussion platform.

description.description: Category description from politics_bbs_categories.description field explaining scope and content guidelines for appropriate category usage within the politicsBBS discussion organization system.

IPoliticsBbsCategory.ISummary.description:
Lightweight category summary representation for list views and interface contexts where complete category metadata is needed for display and filtering purposes. This summary type is specifically optimized for combination with article information, navigation interfaces, and category selection components within the politicsBBS discussion platform.

The summary provides essential category information while maintaining performance efficiency through selective field inclusion. All intrinsic identifier fields (id, code, name) and configuration attributes (sequence, primary, required, multiplicative) are included to support all category-related UI operations without requiring additional database queries.

This format balances comprehensive category information resolution needs with network efficiency requirements, enabling the atomic operation principle by providing sufficient context in a single API call. The summary is particularly valuable for member dashboards, article creation flows, and browsing interfaces where category context enhances content understanding while maintaining system performance for substantive political and economic discussions.

IPoliticsBbsCategory.ICreate.description:
Request type for creating a new political discussion category in the politicsBBS system. Categories organize economic and political discussions by topic, facilitating content discovery and filtering within the platform.

Categories serve as the primary organizational structure for the discussion board, enabling users to find relevant content pertaining to economic policies, political analysis, international relations, and other policy-focused topics. The designation helps users navigate discussions by thematic focus rather than chronological order.

The system enforces that articles must belong to at least one category, ensuring all submitted content receives appropriate classification. Categories support both primary featured distinction for prominent display and required/optional settings to enforce organizational consistency throughout the political discourse platform.

code.description: Unique category code for internal reference and URL generation. This code must be globally unique across the system and cannot be changed after creation. Used for URL paths and API references, typically formatted in lowercase with hyphens. Examples: 'economic-policy', 'international-relations', 'domestic-politics'. The code serves as the stable identifier for category references throughout the system.

name.description: Display name for the category shown to users in the interface and navigation. Should be human-readable and clearly describe the category focus while maintaining professional tone appropriate for political and economic discourse. Examples: 'Economic Policy', 'International Relations', 'Domestic Politics'. The name provides the primary visual identifier in user interfaces and search filtering.

description.description: Detailed description of the category's purpose and scope, explaining what types of discussions belong within its domain. Helps users understand content guidelines and supports informed category selection during article creation. Should provide clear guidance about appropriate types of economic analysis, political commentary, or policy discussions that align with the category focus while maintaining substantive discourse standards.

color.description: CSS color code for visual identification and UI theming of the category. Used for visual differentiation in category selectors, article badges, and navigation interfaces to enhance visual recognition. Should be specified as hex color codes like '#1E88E5' for blue themes or '#E53935' for red themes, providing visual consistency across the platform. Can be null to use default system styling.

icon.description: Icon identifier for visual representation in category interfaces and navigation elements. Could be CSS class names (e.g., 'fas fa-economy'), fontawesome identifiers (e.g., 'fa-chart-line'), or other icon references from supported icon libraries. Enhances visual recognition and quick identification in category browsers and selection interfaces. Can be null when visual icons are not required or desired.

sequence.description: Display order for category sorting in lists and selection interfaces. Lower numeric values appear first in category drop-downs, navigation menus, and category selection components. Enables moderator control over presentation hierarchy, allowing popular or important categories to be positioned prominently for improved discoverability of economic and political content.

primary.description: Whether this category should be featured prominently in the interface as a primary discussion area. Primary categories receive enhanced visibility in category selectors, home page displays, and navigation elements to improve discoverability of key economic policy, political analysis, or international relations content areas that represent core discussion focuses of the platform.

required.description: Whether this category is mandatory for articles or optional for content classification. When true, articles must be assigned to this category, ensuring consistent organizational structure for essential taxonomy areas like broad political or economic discussions. Can be used to enforce categorization rules or create mandatory category groups that maintain content organization standards across the political discussion platform.

multiplicative.description: Whether multiple categories can be assigned to content simultaneously. When false, articles can only have this single category identifier. When true, allows flexible categorization where articles can belong to multiple overlapping categories such as both 'Economic Policy' and 'Healthcare Policy' for health economics discussions, supporting nuanced content classification appropriate for complex political and economic topics.

code.description: Unique category code for internal reference and URL generation. Same as in create DTO functionality. Can only be changed with moderator privileges.

name.description: Display name for the category shown to users. Same as in create DTO functionality.

description.description: Detailed description of the category's purpose and scope. Same as in create DTO functionality.

color.description: CSS color code for visual identification. Same as in create DTO functionality.

icon.description: Icon identifier for visual representation. Same as in create DTO functionality.

sequence.description: Display order for category sorting. Same as in create DTO functionality.

primary.description: Whether this is a primary featured category. Same as in create DTO functionality.

required.description: Whether this category is required for articles. Same as in create DTO functionality.

multiplicative.description: Whether multiple categories can be assigned to content. Same as in create DTO functionality.

IPoliticsBbsCategory.IUpdate.description: Update DTO for modifying existing discussion categories in the politicsBBS system. Allows moderators to adjust category properties including name, description, visual styling, and configuration flags. All fields are optional to enable partial updates without requiring full category data representation.

search.description: Search query to filter categories by name, code, or description. The search is case-insensitive and matches partial strings using trigram similarity scoring.

primary.description: Filter to show only primary featured categories (true) or non-primary categories (false), or null to show all categories

limit.description: Maximum number of categories to return per page. Defaults to 20 if not specified. Valid range is 1-100.

page.description: Page number for pagination (1-based indexing). Defaults to 1. Higher page numbers retrieve subsequent results when total categories exceed the limit.

order_by.description: Field to sort results by. 'sequence' sorts by display order, 'name' sorts alphabetically, 'created_at' sorts by newest first. Defaults to 'sequence'.

direction.description: Sort direction for the order_by field. 'asc' for ascending, 'desc' for descending order. Defaults to 'asc' for sequence and name, 'desc' for created_at.

IPoliticsBbsCategory.IRequest.description: Search and filtering parameters for retrieving political discussion categories. Supports complex queries across multiple criteria including text search, visibility filters, pagination, and sorting options. This enables users to find relevant categories for organizing economic and political discussions.

id.description: Primary key. Unique identifier for the article.

politics_bbs_category_id.description: Belonged category's ID referencing the politics_bbs_categories table.

politics_bbs_creator_id.description: Creator's ID referencing either politics_bbs_members or politics_bbs_moderators based on actor type.

title.description: Article title displayed to users, limited to 5-150 characters as per business rules.

content.description: Main article content body with 50-10,000 character limit for substantive discussions.

state.description: Article lifecycle state: draft, pending, approved, or rejected for moderation workflow.

view_count.description: Number of times the article has been viewed for popularity tracking.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the article was first created.

updated_at.description: Last modification timestamp for the article.

deleted_at.description: Soft delete timestamp for article removal.

snapshots.description: Historical snapshots capturing article states for audit trails.

comments.description: Comments associated with this article for discussion threads.

file_attachments.description: File attachments associated with this article including images and documents.

IPoliticsBbsArticle.description: Core article entity for the politics discussion board, managing the complete article lifecycle from creation through publication. Articles support title and content with state management, view tracking, and attachment capabilities.

politics_bbs_category_id.description: Category ID this article should be assigned to

title.description: Article title displayed to users, limited to 5-150 characters as per business rules

content.description: Main article content body with 50-10,000 character limit for substantive discussions

IPoliticsBbsArticle.ICreate.description: Article creation data including title, content, category selection for new article submission. This DTO enforces business rules including minimum content length and title constraints while excluding system-managed fields.

oneOf.description: Filter results to specific category by UUID. References politics_bbs_categories table. Must be a valid category identifier from the existing category system focused on economic and political topics.

category_id.description: Filter results to specific category by UUID. References politics_bbs_categories table. This enables users to focus their search within specific discussion categories like Economic Policy, International Relations, or Political Analysis as defined in the politicsBBS platform.

oneOf.description: Filter articles created after this ISO 8601 timestamp. Useful for discovering recent economic and political discussions. Supports discovering content published after specific political events or policy announcements.

created_after.description: Filter articles created after this ISO 8601 timestamp. Useful for discovering recent economic and political discussions. This temporal filtering enables users to find content responding to current events, recent policy changes, or ongoing political developments in the discussion board.

oneOf.description: Filter articles created before this ISO 8601 timestamp. Useful for historical content discovery. Enables browsing of archived discussions and historical perspectives on political and economic topics.

created_before.description: Filter articles created before this ISO 8601 timestamp. Useful for historical content discovery. This filter supports research into past political discourse, economic policy evolution, and longitudinal analysis of discussion trends within the politicsBBS platform.

oneOf.description: Number of results per page, limited to a maximum of 100 for performance optimization. Defaults to 20 if not specified. Optimized for responsive user interfaces in the political discussion platform.

limit.description: Number of results per page, limited to a maximum of 100 for performance optimization. Defaults to 20 if not specified. This pagination parameter ensures manageable result sets for both mobile and desktop interfaces in the politics discussion board platform.

order.description: Sorting direction: 'asc' for ascending or 'desc' for descending order. Defaults to 'desc' for chronological sorting. This enables both recent-first discovery and historical browsing patterns for political and economic content analysis.

oneOf.description: Page number for pagination results, starting from 1. Defaults to 1 if not specified. Supports efficient navigation through large result sets of economic and political discussions.

page.description: Page number for pagination results, starting from 1. Defaults to 1 if not specified. This pagination parameter enables users to navigate through comprehensive search results of political and economic discussions efficiently while maintaining search context.

oneOf.description: Full-text search query across article titles and content. Supports keyword matching and phrase searches with PostgreSQL trigram indexing for optimal performance. Minimum 3 characters required. Searches both economic and political terminology for comprehensive topic coverage.

search.description: Full-text search query across article titles and content. Supports keyword matching and phrase searches with PostgreSQL trigram indexing for optimal performance. Minimum 3 characters required. The search functionality intelligently matches both economic terminology and political discourse language for comprehensive content discovery.

oneOf.description: Sorting criteria: 'created_at', 'view_count', or 'relevance'. Defaults to 'created_at' for politics_bbs_articles table. Chronological organization supports temporal analysis of political and economic discourse evolution.

Sorting criteria: 'created_at', 'view_count', or 'relevance'. Defaults to 'created_at' for politics_bbs_articles table. Popularity-based sorting helps identify trending topics and community engagement levels.

Sorting criteria: 'created_at', 'view_count', or 'relevance'. Defaults to 'created_at' for politics_bbs_articles table. Relevance scoring prioritizes content most closely matching user search intent and query terms.

sort.description: Sorting criteria for search results: 'created_at' (newest first), 'view_count' (most popular), or 'relevance' (for keyword searches). Defaults to 'created_at'. These sorting options enable diverse content discovery patterns from breaking political news analysis to evergreen economic policy discussions.

IPoliticsBbsArticle.IRequest.description: Search and filtering parameters for politicsBbs articles with comprehensive query capabilities. This type supports advanced search including full-text search across article titles and content, category-based filtering, date range queries, and sorting options optimized for economic and political discourse discovery. The search functionality leverages PostgreSQL's full-text search capabilities with proper indexing on title and content fields for optimal performance. Users can filter by specific categories like Economic Policy or International Relations, search within article content, and sort results by relevance, recency, or popularity based on view counts. This enables responsive user interfaces for the politics discussion board platform where users need sophisticated content discovery tools for navigating complex political and economic discussions.

id.description: Primary key. Unique identifier for the article. This UUID serves as the definitive reference for the article across all API operations and database relationships within the politics discussion board platform.

title.description: Article title displayed to users, limited to 5-150 characters as per business rules. The title provides the primary identification and discovery mechanism for political and economic content within the discussion platform.

content.description: Main article content body excerpt for summary display. This field provides a content preview suitable for list views while maintaining readability and context for political and economic discourse browsing. The excerpt balances information density with performance optimization for mobile and desktop interfaces.

state.description: Article lifecycle state: draft, pending, approved, or rejected for moderation workflow. This state tracking enables comprehensive content governance while maintaining transparency in the publication process for political and economic discussions.

view_count.description: Number of times the article has been viewed for popularity tracking. This engagement metric supports content discovery algorithms and helps identify trending topics in political and economic discourse within the community.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the article was first created. This temporal information enables chronological organization and supports analysis of political discourse evolution over time within the discussion board platform.

updated_at.description: Last modification timestamp for the article. This tracking supports audit trail requirements and enables users to identify recently updated content in political and economic discussions.

category.description: Associated category for the article. This relationship enables content organization and filtering within the focused economic and political discussion categories defined in the politicsBBS platform.

IPoliticsBbsArticle.ISummary.description: Lightweight representation of a politicsBBS article optimized for list views, dashboard displays, and embedding contexts. This summary DTO provides essential article metadata without full content loading, enabling efficient browsing of political and economic discussions while maintaining responsive user interfaces. The summary includes identification data, basic content preview suitable for list displays, category assignment for topical organization, creation and modification timestamps for temporal context, view count metrics for popularity assessment, and moderation status for content governance transparency. This design pattern supports performance optimization by reducing data transfer overhead while preserving sufficient information for meaningful content discovery and user engagement within the politics discussion board platform focused on economic policy debates and political discourse.

title.description: Updated article title, limited to 5-150 characters as per business rules

content.description: Updated article content body with 50-10,000 character limit for substantive discussions

politics_bbs_category_id.description: Updated category ID this article should be assigned to

IPoliticsBbsArticle.IUpdate.description: Updated article information including title, content, and category assignment. All fields are optional to enable partial updates while maintaining flexibility for various edit scenarios. The 24-hour editing window restricts modification capability to prevent abuse of content integrity after publication.

id.description: Primary key. Unique identifier for the file attachment.

politics_bbs_article_id.description: Attached article's ID referencing the politics_bbs_articles table.

politics_bbs_member_id.description: Uploading member's ID referencing the politics_bbs_members table. This field is required as per the database schema but represents a design flaw since visitors can also upload files through the polymorphic attachment system. The schema should support nullable member_id to accommodate visitor uploads, or use a different ownership pattern.

filename.description: Original filename of the uploaded document.

file_size.description: Size of the document file in bytes. Maximum 10MB allowed.

mime_type.description: MIME type of the document (application/pdf, application/msword, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, text/plain).

file_path.description: Storage path or URL reference to the document file.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the file was uploaded.

article.description: Relationship to the article this file attachment belongs to.

member.description: Relationship to the member who uploaded this file.

image_attachments.description: Image attachments that are part of this file attachment (for composite uploads).

visitor_attachment.description: Visitor-specific attachment relationship if this file was uploaded by a visitor.

member_attachment.description: Member-specific attachment relationship if this file was uploaded by a member.

moderator_attachment.description: Moderator-specific attachment relationship if this file was uploaded by a moderator.

IPoliticsBbsFileAttachment.description: Document file attachments for articles supporting up to 10MB per file and 5 files per article. Manages document uploads with format validation for PDF, DOC, DOCX, and TXT formats. The schema enforces that all file attachments must have a member creator, but this creates an inconsistency with the polymorphic attachment ownership pattern that also supports visitor and moderator uploads through separate association tables.

id.description: Unique identifier for the comment record

politics_bbs_article_id.description: Reference to the article this comment belongs to

parent_id.description: Reference to parent comment for threading support, null for top-level comments

content.description: Comment content text supporting rich text formatting, 20-1000 characters for meaningful dialogue

depth.description: Nesting level for threaded comments (0, 1, or 2) enforcing 3-level thread limit

status.description: Comment moderation status: pending, approved, rejected, or flagged

actor_type.description: Type of actor who created this comment: visitor, member, or moderator

created_at.description: Comment creation timestamp for audit trail

deleted_at.description: Soft delete timestamp for comment removal

IPoliticsBbsComment.description: Core comment entity for the politics discussion board, supporting threaded discussions for articles. Comments maintain state, moderation status, and support polymorphic ownership through subtypes for visitors, members, and moderators. The threaded comment system enables meaningful dialogue while enforcing a 3-level nesting limit to prevent overly complex discussion trees.

IPoliticsBbsComment.ICreate.description: Request DTO for creating a new comment on a politicsBBS article with support for threaded discussions and user authentication context. This DTO enables members to submit meaningful dialogue while maintaining proper content validation and moderation workflows. The system supports threading with up to 3 levels of nesting depth. When creating a reply to an existing comment, the system calculates the appropriate depth level and validates against the maximum nesting constraint. Comments maintain polymorphic ownership patterns where different user types (visitors, members, moderators) create comments through dedicated subtype relationships based on the authenticated user's role. Content validation ensures comments provide meaningful dialogue while preventing spam and inappropriate content. The operation creates the base comment entity and associated subtype entity based on the user's role type, maintaining proper referential integrity. On successful creation, the system returns the complete comment information including generated IDs and timestamps. Comments are initially created with 'pending' status by default, which moderators can then approve for publication, ensuring quality control over the discussion content while maintaining quick user feedback during the posting process.

content.description: Comment content text supporting rich text formatting, 20-1000 characters for meaningful dialogue. Comments should provide substantive discussion content and avoid spam or inappropriate material. Content must remain focused on economic and political topics while maintaining respectful discourse standards.

parent_id.description: Parent comment's ID for threading support. Maximum threading depth is 3 levels. When null, creates a top-level comment on the article. Supports nested discussions to encourage meaningful dialogue flow within article contexts.

ip.description: Client IP address for session tracking (OPTIONAL - server can extract, but client may provide for SSR). Used for audit and session management across the discussion platform. Supports both IPv4 and IPv6 formats for comprehensive tracking.

href.description: Connection URL (current page URL) - MANDATORY. Required for proper session context tracking and audit trail. Must be a valid URI pointing to the current discussion page where comment is being submitted.

referrer.description: Referrer URL (previous page URL) - MANDATORY. Required for navigation tracking and user journey analysis. Must be a valid URI pointing to the page that led users to current discussion.

IPoliticsBbsComment.IRequest.description:
Advanced search and filtering parameters for politics discussion board comments with comprehensive query capabilities. This DTO supports sophisticated comment discovery through multi-criteria filtering including moderation status, actor participation types, thread depth levels, and full-text search across comment content.

The system implements a polymorphic comment ownership pattern where visitors, members, and moderators create comments through dedicated subtype relationships. Comments support threaded discussions up to 3 levels deep with proper nesting constraint enforcement. Full-text search leverages PostgreSQL's trigram similarity indexing for optimal performance across the politics_bbs_comments table content field.

Filtering capabilities enable content moderation teams to efficiently manage approval workflows, identify potentially problematic discussions, and track community engagement across different user roles. The search functionality helps users discover relevant perspectives on economic policies, political developments, and regulatory discussions while maintaining appropriate privacy boundaries for various participant types.

Pagination support ensures efficient handling of large comment threads while maintaining optimal API performance. The comprehensive querying system serves both community members seeking relevant political discourse perspectives and moderators ensuring content quality standards for substantive economic policy discussions.

oneOf.description: Filter to show only comments created by visitor users (unauthenticated guests with temporary session access)
Filter to show only comments created by authenticated member users with full posting privileges
Filter to show only comments created by moderator users with administrative privileges for content governance
When null, includes comments from all actor types for comprehensive result sets

actor_type.description: Filter comments by the type of user who created them. The politicsBBS system implements a polymorphic ownership pattern where different user roles create comments through dedicated subtype tables. Visitor comments come from temporary guest accounts, member comments from authenticated users with posting privileges, and moderator comments from administrative users with enhanced permissions for content governance and community management.

oneOf.description: Filter by specific nesting depth: 0 for top-level comments, 1 for first-level replies, 2 for second-level replies
When null, includes comments at all depth levels for complete thread visibility

depth.description: Filter comments by their nesting depth within threaded discussions. The politics discussion board enforces a maximum 3-level threading constraint (depths 0-2) to prevent overly complex discussion trees while enabling meaningful dialogue flow. Top-level comments (depth 0) appear directly under articles, first-level replies (depth 1) respond to top-level comments, and second-level replies (depth 2) provide the deepest supported nesting for nuanced policy discussions.

oneOf.description: Sort results in ascending order by the specified sort_by field (oldest first for timestamps, A-Z for text fields)
Sort results in descending order by the specified sort_by field (newest first for timestamps, Z-A for text fields)
When null, defaults to descending order for optimal user experience with newest discussions appearing first

order_by.description: Controls the sorting direction for comment results. Ascending order displays comments from oldest to newest or alphabetically A-Z, while descending order shows newest comments first or reverse alphabetical order. This enables users to navigate discussions chronologically or find specific comments through alphabetical sorting when appropriate sort criteria are selected.

page.description: Page number for paginated results starting from 1. Used to navigate through large comment sets efficiently while maintaining optimal database performance. Higher page numbers retrieve subsequent batches of comments based on the specified limit and sorting parameters.

limit.description: Maximum number of comments to return per page, limited to 100 for performance optimization. Larger limits enable viewing more comments at once but may impact response time for threads with extensive discussion activity.

search.description: Full-text search query for filtering comments by content keywords and phrases. The search leverages PostgreSQL's pg_trgm extension with trigram similarity matching against the politics_bbs_comments.content field. This enables discovery of relevant perspectives on specific political topics, economic policies, or regulatory discussions across all comment threads. Search supports natural language queries and partial matching to help users find discussions about particular policy positions, legislative developments, or economic analysis within the comprehensive comment database.

oneOf.description: Filter to show only comments awaiting moderation approval before public visibility

status.description: Filter comments by their moderation status within the content governance workflow. The politicsBBS platform implements a comprehensive moderation system where comments transition through different states: pending (awaiting review), approved (publicly visible), rejected (removed for policy violations), and flagged (community-reported for review). This enables content moderation teams to manage approval workflows efficiently while supporting community members in navigating the discussion platform's content quality standards.

id.description: Primary key identifier from politics_bbs_comments.id field. This UUID serves as the unique reference for individual comments across the polymorphic ownership system, enabling precise linking to specific discussion contributions regardless of whether created by visitors, members, or moderators. The identifier supports comment threading navigation, moderation workflows, and user activity tracking throughout the politics discussion board platform.

politics_bbs_article_id.description: Foreign key reference to politics_bbs_articles.id field indicating which article this comment belongs to. This relationship enables the threaded discussion system where comments are organized under their parent articles, supporting the complete conversation flow from article publication through community discussion and moderation. The reference maintains referential integrity across the content management system while enabling efficient querying of all comments associated with specific economic policy discussions or political analysis articles.

oneOf.description: Reference to parent comment's politics_bbs_comments.id field for threading support. Non-null values indicate this comment is a reply to another comment within the threaded discussion system. The parent-child relationship enables the 3-level nesting constraint while preserving conversation context and reply chains within political and economic policy discussions.
Null value indicates this is a top-level comment directly responding to the article rather than replying to another comment

parent_id.description: Threading relationship reference that implements the hierarchical comment system. Parent comments can have multiple child replies, while child comments maintain reference to their immediate parent within the constrained threading depth. This enables meaningful dialogue flow without overwhelming nested complexity that could hinder productive political discourse.

content.description: Comment text content from politics_bbs_comments.content field, supporting 20-1000 characters for substantive dialogue. The content field stores the complete comment text including any rich formatting, enabling comprehensive discussion of economic policies, political developments, and regulatory analysis. Content is indexed with PostgreSQL's pg_trgm extension for efficient full-text search across political discourse while maintaining quality standards through the moderation workflow system.

depth.description: Nesting level from politics_bbs_comments.depth field enforcing the 3-level thread limit (values 0-2). This integer represents how deeply nested the comment is within the conversation thread: 0 for top-level article responses, 1 for first-level replies to comments, and 2 for the maximum supported nesting depth. The constraint prevents overly complex discussion trees while enabling sufficient dialogue depth for nuanced political and economic policy discussions within the platform community.

status.description: Moderation status from politics_bbs_comments.status field indicating the comment's position within the content governance workflow. Status values include pending (awaiting moderator review), approved (publicly visible), rejected (removed for policy violations), and flagged (community-reported requiring attention). This status system enables quality control over political discourse while supporting transparent moderation practices essential for maintaining community trust in economic and political discussion environments.

actor_type.description: Creator type from politics_bbs_comments.actor_type field implementing the polymorphic ownership pattern. Values indicate which user role created the comment: visitor (temporary guest accounts), member (authenticated users with posting privileges), or moderator (administrative users with content governance permissions). This classification enables appropriate attribution, permission management, and community accountability while supporting the comprehensive audit trail system required for political discussion platform integrity.

created_at.description: Timestamp from politics_bbs_comments.created_at field recording when the comment was submitted to the discussion board. This ISO 8601 datetime provides chronological ordering for threaded discussions, supports activity tracking and analytics, and enables temporal filtering for content discovery. The timestamp is essential for maintaining conversation flow integrity and supporting moderation response time metrics within the politicsBBS economic and political discourse platform.

IPoliticsBbsComment.ISummary.description:

The summary maintains core identity and status tracking while excluding detailed content processing and moderation information unnecessary for basic display requirements. IPoliticsBbsComment.IUpdate.description: Request DTO for updating existing comment content with full validation for length and quality requirements. Users can only edit their own comments regardless of actor type. This DTO enables content correction while maintaining conversation integrity and audit trails. Content validation ensures comments provide meaningful dialogue while preventing spam and inappropriate material. The operation validates the new content against business rules for comment quality and length requirements. It preserves the existing comment's metadata including creation timestamp, author information, and conversation thread placement while updating only the content field. This operation supports the threaded discussion system by allowing content correction and updates while maintaining conversation integrity. It integrates with the comment moderation workflow by preserving existing status flags during content updates.

IPoliticsBbsUpload.ICreate.description:
Request DTO for creating file uploads including the file content and metadata for the politicsBBS discussion board attachment system. This DTO handles file upload operations with comprehensive validation ensuring file safety and compliance with platform requirements including the polymorphic ownership model supporting visitors, members, and moderators.

The upload process validates file types against accepted formats, enforces size limitations (5MB maximum for images, 10MB maximum for documents) as specified in the politics_bbs_file_attachments and politics_bbs_image_attachments tables, and conducts malware scanning before acceptance. Images are automatically processed to generate thumbnails and optimized versions. Document uploads support PDF, DOC, DOCX, and TXT formats as defined in the MIME type constraints.

All uploads maintain audit trails through session context fields that capture connection information for security monitoring and populate the appropriate subtype tables (politics_bbs_attachment_of_visitors, politics_bbs_attachment_of_members, politics_bbs_attachment_of_moderators) based on the authenticated user context. The operation supports the complete upload workflow from initial validation through secure storage and category association.
