oneOf.description: Ascending sorting direction for politics discussion board result ordering. Supports natural progression from lowest-to-highest values commonly used for alphabetical ordering, chronological sequencing, and numerical magnitude filtering in political discourse discovery workflows.

Descending sorting direction for politics discussion board result ordering. Supports high-to-low value progression ideal for popularity ranking, reverse chronological displays, and ranking-based filtering by engagement metrics in political discussion results.

IEPageSortDirection.description: Sorting direction control for politicsBBS API result pagination, supporting standard ascending and descending ordering patterns optimized for political discussion platform user interfaces where users filter economic and policy content chronologically or by community engagement metrics.

query.description: Search query text that will be processed through the database using trigram similarity matching. This query supports natural language input and will be tokenized for effective matching against article titles, content, and comment text across the politicsBBS platform.

page.description: Page number for paginated search results, starting from 1 for the first page of results. Used for navigation and state management in the search interface.

limit.description: Number of results per page, with sensible limits to ensure reasonable response times. The system enforces both minimum and maximum values to balance user experience with system performance.

oneOf.description: Filter to search only within articles
Filter to search only within comments
When null, search across all content types for comprehensive results

contentType.description: Optional content type filter to narrow search results allowing users to focus on specific types of content or search across all content types for comprehensive discovery of political and economic discussions.

categoryIds.description: Optional array of category identifiers to filter search results within specific political or economic discussion categories enabling targeted searching within particular policy areas or economic topics.

oneOf.description: Date range object defining temporal boundaries for search results
When null, search across all time periods without temporal restrictions

dateRange.description: Optional date range filter to limit search results to specific time periods enabling users to focus searches on recent discussions or specific historical periods relevant to political developments.

items.description: Filter by visitor-created content for public discussions and articles without authentication requirements
items.description_1: Filter by member-created content representing authenticated user contributions including articles and comments
items.description_2: Filter by moderator-created content including administrative posts and official platform communications

userRoles.description: Optional array of user roles to filter search results by content creator type enabling searching within specific user groups for targeted discovery of political discourse contributions.

IPoliticsBbsSearch.IRequest.description: Request parameters for unified search across all discussion board content including articles, comments, and user-generated content. This search system utilizes PostgreSQL's full-text search capabilities with trigram similarity matching combined with advanced filtering options to provide comprehensive discovery of economic and political discussions across the entire platform. The search mechanism supports temporal filtering, category-based refinement, and multi-role content discovery to help users find relevant policy analyses, economic discourse, and political commentary with precision and efficiency.

pagination.description: Pagination metadata including current page, total results count, and navigation information providing users with clear indication of their position within search results

results.description: Array of matching search result items containing articles, comments, and other searchable content with sufficient preview information to help users determine relevance without requiring additional API calls

IPoliticsBbsSearchResult.description: Search result structure representing the complete response from the politicsBBS unified search endpoint. This entity encompasses both the metadata about the search operation and the actual matching content discovered through full-text search processes. The search results are optimized for efficient browsing of political and economic discussions while maintaining semantic relevance and temporal context for comprehensive content discovery across the entire politics discussion board platform.

IDateRange.description:
Date range specification for filtering search results and other temporal queries within the politicsBBS platform.

This structure enables users to narrow search results to specific time periods relevant to political and economic discussions. The date range implementation supports comprehensive search scenarios from tracking policy announcement timelines to analyzing economic trend discussions during specific legislative periods.

By establishing clear temporal boundaries, the system enables both casual educators and professional analysts to filter political and economic content with precision, ensuring relevant discourse discovery across the comprehensive timeline of democratic dialogue and fiscal policy evolution.

The structured approach helps users navigate complex political and economic discussions chronologically, making it easier to understand policy evolution, track legislative changes, and analyze the temporal progression of economic policies and political discourse on the platform. Date ranges support both recent content discovery and historical analysis for comprehensive political knowledge management.

from.description:
Start date for the specified time period, formatted as an ISO 8601 datetime string.

This field establishes the temporal starting point for date range filtering within the politicsBBS search system. The ISO 8601 format ensures consistent parsing across different systems and maintains timezone awareness, essential for a global discussion platform where political events span multiple regions.

The field is critical for enabling users to narrow search results to specific time periods relevant to their interests in political and economic discussions. Date-time boundaries support comprehensive temporal analysis for policy tracking and political discourse exploration.

to.description:
End date for the specified time period, formatted as an ISO 8601 datetime string.

This field establishes the temporal ending point for date range filtering and works in conjunction with 'from' to create a complete temporal filtering mechanism. The ISO 8601 standard ensures reliable boundary resolution for political and economic discourse content discovery.

The field enables precise limit searches to specific periods relevant to political developments or economic policy analysis. Proper date-time formatting maintains consistency across the platform for temporal query operations.

IPoliticsBbsArticleSnapshot.description: Historical snapshots of articles capturing point-in-time states for audit trails and version tracking. Snapshots preserve complete article content when articles are modified, enabling rollback capabilities and maintaining a complete history of content changes over time. This forms the content management audit trail system that allows moderators and authors to track content evolution throughout the publication lifecycle.

id.description: Unique identifier for the article snapshot record

politics_bbs_article_id.description: Reference to the source article this snapshot belongs to

title.description: Snapshot of article title at this point in time, exactly as it appeared when the snapshot was created

content.description: Snapshot of article content body at this point in time, preserving the complete text content

state.description: Snapshot of article lifecycle state when this snapshot was created (draft, pending, approved, or rejected)

view_count.description: View count snapshot for historical tracking, capturing the number of times the article had been viewed

created_at.description: Timestamp when this snapshot was created for audit trail purposes

IPoliticsBbsVisitor.description: Visitor accounts with read-only access to published content. Visitors can browse articles, view attachments, and search content without authentication requirements.

id.description: Primary key. Unique identifier for the visitor.

username.description: Unique username for display purposes, 3-20 characters using letters, numbers, and hyphens only.

password_hash.description: Hashed password for visitor authentication using secure algorithms with appropriate salting.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the visitor account was created.

last_seen_at.description: Timestamp of the visitor's last activity on the platform.

IPoliticsBbsMember.description: Member accounts with content creation privileges including article creation, commenting, and file uploads. Members can manage their own content within 24-hour editing window.

id.description: Primary key. Unique identifier for the member.

username.description: Unique username for member identification, 3-20 characters using letters, numbers, and hyphens only.

password_hash.description: Hashed password for member authentication using secure algorithms with appropriate salting.

email.description: Email address for account recovery and notifications, must be unique across the system.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the member account was registered.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent profile update.

deleted_at.description: Soft delete timestamp for member account suspension.

id.description: Primary key. Unique identifier for the image attachment.

politics_bbs_attachment_id.description: Main attachment entity's ID referencing the politics_bbs_file_attachments table.

filename.description: Original filename of the uploaded image.

file_size.description: Size of the image file in bytes. Maximum 5MB allowed.

file_path.description: Storage path or URL reference to the image file.

width.description: Image width in pixels for display optimization.

height.description: Image height in pixels for display optimization.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the image was uploaded.

attachment.description: Relationship to the main file attachment this image belongs to.

IPoliticsBbsImageAttachment.description: Image attachments for articles using polymorphic ownership pattern. Image attachments support metadata extraction and image processing for display optimization.

IPoliticsBbsContentReview.ISummary.description:
Summary information for a politics discussion board content review. This DTO contains essential details about individual content reviews with categorized reasoning, enabling moderators to quickly assess and process review requests.

Content reviews are created when articles are submitted for moderation or when they are flagged by the community. The review process focuses on ensuring content adheres to community guidelines while maintaining the platform's focus on economic and political discourse.

The summary format provides just enough information for moderation queue displays and quick decision-making, excluding detailed content data that would be visible in full detail views.

id.description: Unique identifier for the content review record. Used for tracking individual review requests through the moderation process.

politics_bbs_article_id.description: Reference to the article being reviewed. Links to the original article content that is under review.

politics_bbs_category_id.description: Category of the article under review. Provides context for moderation decisions based on content topic and category-specific guidelines.

category_code.description: Short code identifier for the category. Enables quick categorization for moderation queue filtering and context.

category_name.description: Human-readable name for the article category. Helps moderators understand content context at a glance.

article_title.description: Title of the article under review. Essential for quick identification and assessment of content.

article_creator.description: Summary information about the article creator. Includes basic profile information to provide context for the review.

review_type.description: Type of review requested: initial_submission or community_flagged. Indicates why this content is under review.

priority.description: Priority level for review processing: normal (default) or urgent (for flagged content). Helps prioritize urgent community reports over routine submissions.

violations.description: List of policy violations identified during review processing. Based on automated content scanning and community reports.

status.description: Current status of the review: pending, under_review, approved, rejected, or appealed. Tracks progression through the moderation workflow.

reviewed_by.description: Identifier of the moderator handling this review. Links to the responsible moderator once review begins.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this review was first requested. Used for queue ordering and SLA tracking.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent review update or change. Tracks review progression and enables timeout detection.

expires_at.description: Deadline for completing this review based on priority level. Ensures timely processing of urgent community flags.

IPoliticsBbsArticleCreator.ISummary.description:
Summary information about the creator of a politics discussion board article. This DTO provides essential creator profile information for review and moderation contexts, enabling quick assessment of content authenticity and community standing.

This summary focuses on identity verification basics rather than detailed profile information, making it suitable for queue displays and quick moderation decisions where creator reputation and verification status matter more than extensive profile data.

id.description: Unique identifier for the article creator. Essential for linking articles to their creators across all review and moderation processes.

username.description: Public display name or username of the content creator. Used for attribution in review contexts and serves as the visible identifier for moderation teams.

account_type.description: Type of account holder: member or moderator. Essential for understanding creator privileges and context during review processes.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the creator's account was established. Useful for identifying new vs established users and potential reputation factors in review.

IPoliticsBbsSearchResult.IPagination.description: Pagination information for search results including current position and navigation data. Essential for handling large search result sets and providing users with intuitive navigation controls through their search discovery experience.

page.description: Current page number (1-indexed) indicating the user's position within the paginated results. Used for navigation and state management in the search interface.

limit.description: Number of results displayed per page. Determines the chunk size for result presentation and affects user experience with search result browsing.

total.description: Total count of matching search results across all pages. Provides users with comprehensive understanding of result set size and helps determine search precision.

totalPages.description: Total number of pages required to display all search results. Calculated based on total results count and per-page limit for navigation planning.

IPoliticsBbsSearchResult.IItem.description: Individual search result item containing preview information about articles, comments, or other content matching the search query. Each item provides sufficient context to enable users to evaluate relevance and decide whether to view the full content.

id.description: Unique identifier of the searchable content item allowing direct access to the full content. Used for linking search results to detailed views and API endpoints.

oneOf.description: Content type classification determining the type of content: 'article', 'comment', or other searchable entities. Influences display format and navigation behavior for different content types.
Content type classification determining the type of content: 'article', 'comment', or other searchable entities. Influences display format and navigation behavior for different content types.

type.description: Content type classification determining the type of content: 'article', 'comment', or other searchable entities. Influences display format and navigation behavior for different content types.

title.description: Primary title or heading for the search result item. For articles, this is the article title; for comments, it may be a preview of the comment content or related article title.

excerpt.description: Content excerpt or preview text showing the relevance match to the search query. Provides users with context about why this item matched their search terms without requiring additional API calls.

author.description: Author information including username and role. Helps users evaluate source credibility and expertise when browsing search results.

category.description: Category information providing context about the discussion topic. Enables users to filter results by category relevance and understand the political or economic focus area.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the content was created. Used for sorting by recency and displaying temporal relevance to users.

relevance_score.description: Calculated relevance score indicating how closely the content matches the search query. Higher scores indicate stronger relevance matches and better alignment with user search intent.

IPoliticsBbsSearchResult.IAuthor.description: Author information providing attribution for search result content. Includes user identification and role information to help users evaluate source credibility and expertise when browsing search results.

id.description: Unique identifier of the content author used for profile navigation and author-based filtering.

username.description: Display username of the content author that appears alongside search results and serves as the author's public persona within the discussion board.

role.description: User role classification determining permission levels and credibility indicators. Helps users understand the author's authority level within the platform.

IPoliticsBbsSearchResult.ICategory.description: Category information providing topical context for search results. Categories help users navigate the political and economic discussion landscape and identify content relevant to their interests.

code.description: Short category code used for URL generation and API references. Categories include political topics like economic-policy, fiscal-analysis, international-relations, etc.

color.description: Optional color designation for visual categorization in user interfaces. May be null for categories without predetermined color schemes.

id.description: Unique identifier for the content category enabling category-based filtering and navigation.

name.description: Human-readable category name suitable for display in user interfaces. Categories include Economic Policy, Political Analysis, International Relations, etc.

IPoliticsBbsAttachmentOfVisitor.description: Association table for visitor-created image attachments implementing polymorphic ownership pattern. Visitors can upload images for validation through proper subtype relationship.

id.description: Primary key. Unique identifier for the visitor attachment association.

politics_bbs_attachment_id.description: Attachment's ID this subtype belongs to.

created_at.description: Timestamp when visitor uploaded this attachment

attachment.description: Relationship to the main file attachment this visitor upload belongs to.

visitor.description: Relationship to the visitor who uploaded this attachment.

IPoliticsBbsAttachmentOfMember.description: Association table for member-created image attachments implementing polymorphic ownership pattern. Members can upload images and files for their articles through proper subtype relationship.

id.description: Primary key. Unique identifier for the member attachment association.

politics_bbs_attachment_id.description: Attachment's ID this subtype belongs to.

created_at.description: Timestamp when member uploaded this attachment

attachment.description: Relationship to the main file attachment this member upload belongs to.

member.description: Relationship to the member who uploaded this attachment.

IPoliticsBbsAttachmentOfModerator.description: Association table for moderator-created image attachments implementing polymorphic ownership pattern. Moderators can upload images for moderation and administrative content.

id.description: Primary key. Unique identifier for the moderator attachment association.

politics_bbs_attachment_id.description: Attachment's ID this subtype belongs to.

created_at.description: Timestamp when moderator uploaded this attachment

attachment.description: Relationship to the main file attachment this moderator upload belongs to.

moderator.description: Relationship to the moderator who uploaded this attachment.

IPoliticsBbsPopularArticle.description: Popular article representation with enhanced analytics focusing on community engagement metrics, creator attribution, and category organization for effective content curation within the politics discussion board platform.

author.description: Content creator username from politics_bbs_members.username or politics_bbs_moderators.username based on creator type. Provides attribution while maintaining appropriate privacy settings for the discussion platform.

category.description: Category name from politics_bbs_categories.name field for content organization and filtering. Categories include Economic Policy, International Relations, Political Analysis, and other business categories within the politics discussion board.

createdAt.description: Article creation timestamp from politics_bbs_articles.created_at field. Used for calculating content freshness and determining temporal relevance in popularity algorithms.

engagementHours.description: Recent engagement activity within the last 48 hours, calculated from politics_bbs_articles.view_count and timing analytics. Indicates current community interest versus historical popularity metrics.

id.description: Primary key identifier linking to politics_bbs_articles.id for article references and tracking systems within the discussion board platform.

rating.description: Computed popularity score combining view statistics, recency, and engagement velocity. Enables ranking of trending political and economic discussions within the platform community.

title.description: Article title extracted from politics_bbs_articles.title field with 5-150 character limits per business requirements. Used for identification and search functionality within the politics discussion board system.

trend.description: Momentum indicator: hot for rapidly rising engagement, trending up for steady growth, stable for consistent popularity. Based on recent engagement patterns within the politics discussion board community.

viewCount.description: Total article views accumulated from politics_bbs_articles.view_count field. Represents cumulative reader engagement and forms a key component of the popularity calculation algorithm for trending content identification.

IPoliticsBbsPopularArticles.description:
Collection of popular articles from the politics discussion board, identified through statistical analysis of view counts, recent engagement metrics, and publication recency. This response provides curated trending content discovery functionality with associated category information for proper content organization.

The popularity algorithm considers multiple factors including total view counts, recent engagement within the last 24-48 hours, and publication timeliness to surface both established discussions with sustained interest and new content gaining community attention. Only approved articles (state: approved) are included to maintain content quality standards. Articles are linked to their categories through the politics_bbs_categories table to enable category-based filtering and discovery.

This statistical response supports the atomic operation principle by delivering complete popular content data in a single API call, eliminating the need for additional filtering or sorting operations on the client side while maintaining proper category organization for the politicsBBS economic and political discussion platform.

popularArticles.description: List of popular articles sorted by popularity metrics and engagement statistics, representing current community interest on economic and political topics with category association data.

text: I'll now create comprehensive end-to-end test suites to ensure all your API endpoints work correctly together. These tests will validate user registration, article creation, commenting, and file upload functionality.

instruction:
Create E2E tests covering:

User Authentication Flow:
- User can register successfully
- User can login with valid credentials
- User cannot register with duplicate username
- Invalid login attempt should fail

Article Management:
- User can create article with title and content
- User can create article with attachments
- User can list articles by category
- User can view article details
- User can update their own article
- User cannot update others' articles

Commenting System:
- User can add comment to article
- User can reply to existing comment
- User can delete their own comment
- User cannot delete others' comments

File Uploads:
- Image upload works correctly
- File attachment upload works
- Uploaded files can be retrieved

Category Operations:
- Categories can be listed
- Admin can create new categories

Test both successful operations and error cases. Include authorization checks and data validation tests.

scenario.draft: Test successful visitor account creation with valid username and password. The visitor should receive JWT tokens upon successful registration and be able to access the discussion board with read-only permissions. This validates the basic visitor authentication flow and token generation functionality.

dependencies.purpose:
Essential authentication prerequisite:
This join operation (post /auth/visitor/join) must be executed before any operations requiring 'visitor' actor authorization.
It establishes the necessary user account and authentication context for the 'visitor' actor, enabling subsequent API calls that depend on this specific authorization level.
Without this join operation, the main scenario endpoint and its dependencies will fail due to insufficient authentication credentials.

scenario.draft: Test that duplicate visitor usernames are rejected by the system. Create one visitor account, then attempt to create another with the same username. The system should return an appropriate error indicating the username is already taken.

Test member registration failure when attempting to register with a username that already exists. Verify that the system rejects the registration request and returns an appropriate error message indicating the username is already taken.

scenario.draft: Test successful image file upload by authenticated member. scenario.draft: Test that file upload attempts without proper authentication are rejected. Verifies authorization requirements and security measures prevent unauthorized file uploads to the discussion board.

It tests the complete file management workflow from upload to metadata access, ensuring users can view attachment details after successful uploads.

scenario.draft: Test retrieval of file metadata with invalid upload ID. This scenario validates that the system properly handles requests for non-existent file uploads with appropriate error responses, ensuring robust error handling for invalid upload identifiers.

Test article search with queries that should return no results. Validate proper handling of non-matching keywords, combination of conflicting filters, and edge cases like very specific search terms. Ensure system gracefully handles empty result sets with appropriate response format and pagination.

dependencies.purpose: Create authenticated member context for test setup

scenario.draft: Test that a member can successfully delete their own comment on an article. This scenario validates the complete workflow where a member creates an article, adds a comment to it, and then deletes that comment. Verify that deletion is permanent and the comment is marked as deleted while preserving content integrity for audit purposes.

Test category filtering by primary status. Validates that users can filter categories to show only primary categories for featured content browsing. Ensures filtering logic correctly separates primary categories from secondary categories in search results.

text: I'll now implement the API business logic for your economic/political discussion board. Let me create the service implementations for all the endpoints.

instruction:
Implement the business logic for the discussion board API with these requirements:

User Authentication:
- Simple registration with username and password
- Password hashing for security
- JWT token generation for authentication
- Login validation

Article Management:
- Users can create articles with title, content, and category
- Support for attaching images and files
- Track view counts
- Users can only edit/delete their own articles
- Support both draft and published status

Comment System:
- Threaded comments (replies to comments)
- Users can only edit/delete their own comments
- Simple chronological ordering

File Upload:
- Handle image and document uploads
- Store file metadata (original name, size, type, path)
- Support multiple attachments per article
- Simple file validation based on MIME types

Content Security:
- Basic input validation for all endpoints
- Sanitize HTML content to prevent XSS
- Rate limiting for API endpoints
- Simple authorization checks

Database Operations:
- Use Prisma ORM for all database interactions
- Proper relationships between users, articles, comments, and files
- Handle database transactions where needed
- Include proper error handling

The implementation should be straightforward, focusing on core functionality without complex features or over-engineering.
